facts.activity_file: removing isolation and returning to operations

control_failures.control_label: application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: unplanned release of electrical energy at P-9502

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on P-9502, M-9502 and PT-9502 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically removing isolation and returning to operations. P-9502 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 21 February 2024 a high potential incident was recorded on P-9502, M-9502 and PT-9502 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during start-up after maintenance; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
